ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across >85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity white pixels localized to scars and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigment across both lobes; vertical high-intensity linear streaks clustered in the lower medial region of the left lobe; multiple circular white rings (diameter 10-20 pixels) on the right lobe; dense high-intensity white clusters at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at approximately 45 degrees; the apex is partially occluded by high-intensity water spray/splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels along the inner trailing edges; becomes highly irregular and jagged at the tips due to external accretions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve on the lateral edges, tapering to narrow, upward-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white clusters (barnacles) at both lobe tips; distinct circular/annular white scars present on the central and outer right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical white linear marks (rake marks) on the left lobe near the notch; faint diagonal linear scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the tips; vertical rake marks on the inner left lobe; multiple circular impact/attachment scars on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent brownish-white organic mass (algae/barnacle cluster) protruding significantly from the tip of the right lobe.
